About Us

Since 2004, Translators USA has served American interests both at home and abroad with expert translation and interpretation services. We are a translation company who specialize in making multi-language conferences and conversations more successful, whether in person, on the phone or video.

We ensure that the written word is shared accurately and in the correct voice, no matter where the document will be used or where the conference takes place. And we take our responsibility seriously: we will provide the best customer service possible because we want to work with you today, tomorrow, and for years to come.

Core Values

Known for our quality, affordability, confidentiality and speed, Translators USA provides translation, interpreting, transcription, localization, proofreading, and audio-visual services to companies and individuals around the world.

At Translators USA, we are driven to create value every day. Our core values are the foundation of our company, essential to our success and serve as the lens through which we evaluate every business decision.

We are known for providing high-value communications services to a wide range of industries including finance, law, healthcare and technology. Complementing meticulous accuracy and surprising affordability, unprecedented accessibility enables our clients meet the tightest feasible deadlines and fastest-arriving event dates. Clear, accurate communication is our passion; language translation and interpretation is our business.

We are devoted to excellence in delivering state of the art services with pocket-friendly prices.

More Services

LIVE CONFERENCE INTERPRETING

At Translators USA, we understand that interpretation is more than just changing words from one language into another. Our language experts know the cultural differences, dialects and local idioms needed to ensure your message is received loud and clear. We have more than 9,000 interpreters and translation specialists in the United States who speak more than 150 different languages and dialects, and we’re rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau. Get a quote now.

CERTIFIED TRANSLATION

Businesses, government agencies and individuals turn to us for certified document services in more than 150 languages. Translators USA is the trusted translator for corporations, governments and school districts, small businesses, marketing agencies, engineering and architectural firms, as well as individuals. Get a quote to see how quickly and affordably we can help.

PROOFREADING & EDITING

Do you need a company report that must be perfect in more than one language? Perhaps you’ve recently gone through the translation process and have questions about the quality of the writing and integrity of the translation. Whether you need both translating and proofreading or a second set of eyes on a completed translation, we’ll ensure your documents are stylistically and grammatically correct. Translators USA is trusted by companies like yours and has the highest A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau. Get started now with a free quote.

TOURING INTERPRETING

We’re always on call. Contact us 7 days a week for all your interpreting needs. We’ll be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we’ll guide you to the right solution to overcome any language barrier.

MEDICAL TRANSCRIPTION

Do you have recordings of a medical conference that need a written transcript? Count on Translators USA for fast, accurate transcriptions of your medical conference or event. Are you planning a stadium-size event for your annual convention or a smaller symposium for medical professionals? We can take care of both interpreting and transcription for any size event in the life sciences field.

APOSTILLE SERVICES

If you need a professional to handle your apostille smoothly and easily, contact us to get a free quote. Just submit a few details about your document. We’ll respond to you within the same business day, and we’ll provide you with a free no-obligation quote with exact pricing and turnaround time.

Our Trusted Partners

Translators USA has served the translation needs of the world’s leading brands in technology, software, aerospace, retail, architecture, network marketing, event planning and many non-profit organizations.
